{"consolidated_memory":"## Malformed Record Issues in ingest/pipeline/parser.py

TWO SEPARATE OCCASIONS:

### Occasion 1: [2026-01-28] — Listener Not Removed on Teardown
- **Component**: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side)
- **Trigger**: First request after cold start
- **Repro**: Feed the mixed-encoding sample file
- **Root Cause**: Signal listener was registered but never removed
- **Error Signal**: Decode error pointing at one byte offset
- **Fix**: Removed listener on teardown; asserted removal in test
- **PR/Branch**: #4503 on fix/malformed-record-1
- **Outcome**: p99 latency fell from 4.7 s to 978 ms
- **Context**: Same corner of parser.py as earlier malformed record work, context carried over

### Occasion 2: [2026-07-27] — Floating Point Rounding in Money Path
- **Component**: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side)
- **Trigger**: Payloads above roughly 2 megabytes
- **Repro**: Feed the mixed-encoding sample file
- **Root Cause**: Floating point rounding in the money path
- **Error Signal**: Decode error pointing at one byte offset
- **Fix**: Moved arithmetic to integer minor units
- **PR/Branch**: #6727 on fix/malformed-record-2
- **Stack**: Python
- **Test Coverage**: tests/ingest/test_parser.py
- **Outcome**: Cold start dropped 37 percent, to 771 ms"}
